dct_description_sm: This dataset includes temperature, pH and means ± standard deviations (n = 3-6) of dissolved ions at sampling sites, calculated free metal ion concentrations and measured metal biofilm content in streams of Nunavik (QC) and Sudbury (ON) in 2016.
dct_title_s: Data for the paper entitled "Exploring the role of water chemistry on metal accumulation in biofilms from streams in mining areas"
